open_points.subject: Model M32 SectionProgress absence semantics
open_points.text: “A section without a record has no recorded progress: its views show `completion_percent = None` and `completed_work_value = None`, never an invented 0 % or an invented zero amount” contradicts “`_project_progress` (absent progress is `None`, value zero).”
open_points.question: When a section has no progress record, is its `completed_work_value` `None` or zero?
options: Return `None`, following the revised Meaning, A9 and INV-044.
Return zero, following the unchanged M32 Carried changes statement.
open_points.default_guess: Return `None` and remove the stale “value zero” statement.

witness.initial: An active budget has a section with `work_planned = 100.00` and no SectionProgress record.
events: A staff member or viewer requests the project overview.
outcomes: The section has `completion_percent = None` and `completed_work_value = None`.
witness.observer: The staff member or viewer reading the section.

open_points.subject: A28 operation boundary for the one wall-clock reading
open_points.text: “an operation that reads the current time … takes one wall reading” and “A route handler … calls exactly one owning use case” do not say whether authentication, authorization and the owning use case share that reading or are separate operations with separate readings.
open_points.question: What is the operation boundary for CLK-001: the whole request, each owning use case, or every independently called authentication/authorization capability?
options: One request-wide wall reading is shared by authentication, authorization and the owning use case, except for the audit writer.
Each independently invoked use case or guard takes its own single reading.
Only the owning mutation/read use case is covered; preliminary authentication and authorization take independent readings.
open_points.default_guess: Use one request-wide wall instant for all request processing except the audit writer's expressly separate reading.

witness.initial: A valid staff session expires at instant T, and a project request begins immediately before T.
events: The authorization guard and owning project use case execute as the wall clock crosses T.
outcomes: A request-wide reading before T is reused, so the request remains authenticated.
A later independent reading at or after T treats the session as expired and returns 401.

open_points.subject: Clock-source ownership and runtime wiring
open_points.text: “one clock source is the only reader of both” is not matched by any `module:clock_source`, clock capability, or clock-source construction in “`capability:runtime.create_runtime_app` builds one `PortalStore` … builds the inner application … installs `capability:transport_guard.install_transport_guards`”.
open_points.question: Which module owns the clock source, which capability exposes its wall and monotonic readings, and who creates and supplies it to identity operations, guards, use cases and the transport rate limiter?
options: `module:runtime` creates one clock-source instance and injects it into every consumer.
A dedicated `module:clock_source` owns construction and exposes wall and monotonic capabilities.
Each consumer constructs its own clock-source adapter while only that adapter reads host clocks.
open_points.default_guess: Define a dedicated clock-source module, instantiate it once in runtime, and inject it into all consumers.

open_points.subject: Photo component of flow:build_project_overview
open_points.question: Which named capability obtains and projects the visible photos for the overview, and which module owns that operation?
options: `derived_views.build_project_overview` reads photo records directly and owns filtering and projection.
It calls `photo_management.list_progress_photos` and adapts that result into the overview.
open_points.default_guess: Add `capability:derived_views.build_photo_view`, owned by `module:derived_views`, using the photo repository as an input dependency.

open_points.subject: Per-component failure handling in flow:build_project_overview
open_points.text: “a failed part is `temporarily_unavailable` with no value” and “A part that cannot be read is marked unavailable” do not define which failures are component failures rather than failures of the whole overview.
open_points.question: For each budget, expense, progress, payment and photo component, which failure classes become `temporarily_unavailable`, and which still propagate through `error_policy`?
options: Only declared storage or dependency read failures become component unavailability; validation, authorization and programming failures propagate.
Every exception raised while building an individual component becomes `temporarily_unavailable`.
Only explicitly enumerated failures per component become unavailable; every other failure propagates.
open_points.default_guess: Enumerate the recoverable read failures per component; convert only those to `temporarily_unavailable` and propagate all others.

witness.initial: The project guard has succeeded, but a stored photo record cannot be decoded while the other overview records are readable.
events: A staff member requests the overview.
The photo component fails during its read or projection.
outcomes: The overview succeeds with `photos_availability = temporarily_unavailable` and no photo value.
The decoding failure propagates and the entire request returns the mapped server error.
witness.observer: The staff member requesting the overview.
